status: relative image-registration diagnostic; not absolute geolocation validation

method.subpixel_refinement: Independent parabolic fit around the 2D normalized-correlation peak
method.score_threshold_rule: 25th percentile of training candidate scores only; applied unchanged to held-out ties
method.fit: Huber-reweighted affine x/y offset field in normalized sample and line coordinates, fit on training blocks only
method.heldout_split: 750-line blocks; block index modulo 3 equals 2; 150-line boundary guard

limitations: Only 17 held-out matches remain after applying the training-only score cutoff; tail quantiles are uncertain at this sample size.
WAC and IIRS morphology ties are not surveyed ground-control points.
The affine offset model is a first diagnostic, not the final correction model.
WAC 100 m pixels and IIRS 80 m pixels differ in spatial response.
Residuals measure held-out consistency relative to this WAC warp, not absolute selenographic error.
A poor match can reflect illumination and morphology differences as well as geolocation error.
